description: 🌍 EcosphereX — MCP-powered Agentic AI for Environmental Protection

readme.content: # 🌍 EcosphereX — MCP-powered Agentic AI for Environmental Protection EcosphereX is a **multi-agent AI system** built during **Google Agentic AI World’s Biggest Hackathon (Hyderabad)** to demonstrate how **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** enables autonomous, collaborative agents for real-time environmental monitoring and early disaster prevention. Environmental disasters rarely occur without warning. Signals exist — polluted water, toxic air spikes, illegal dumping, methane buildup — but they remain fragmented across systems. **EcosphereX unifies these signals into a single, intelligent, always-on AI task force.** --- ## 🚨 Problem We’re Solving Real-world incidents such as: - **Bellandur Lake fire (Bengaluru)** caused by long-term chemical dumping - **Visakhapatnam gas leak (2020)** where warning signals existed hours before the disaster could have been mitigated with: - Integrated monitoring - Early anomaly detection - Autonomous reasoning - Faster alerting --- ## 🧠 Solution Overview EcosphereX is built as a **network of specialized AI agents**, connected via **MCP (Model Context Protocol)**. Each agent: - Has access to its own external tools (APIs, vision models, documents) - Produces structured outputs - Collaborates with other agents in a shared workflow - Operates autonomously or reacts to detected anomalies --- ## 🧩 System Architecture (Multi-Agent Design) ### 1️⃣ Environmental Data Ingestion Agent **Tools (via MCP):** - Satellite imagery fetcher - IoT sensor APIs - Weather APIs - GIS layers - PDF / document loaders **Role:** Collects and normalizes raw environmental data into structured datasets. --- ### 2️⃣ Visual & Spatial Analysis Agent **Tools (via MCP):** - Vision models (YOLO / segmentation) - Geospatial analysis tools **Detects:** - Illegal dumping - Water discoloration - Shoreline changes - Smoke plumes - Chemical leaks **Output:** Geolocation-tagged visual evidence and segmentation results. --- ## 🌙 Example Scenario: Midnight Chemical Leak If a factory releases toxic effluents at **1:30 AM**: 1. Sensor Agent detects abnormal chemical spikes 2. Vision Agent identifies river discoloration 3. Knowledge Agent flags upstream industrial violations 4. Fusion Agent predicts downstream contamination risk 5. Alerting Agent generates maps and reports ➡️ **Authorities are notified within minutes — not days.** --- ## ☁️ Deployment Details - Deployed on **Google Vertex AI** - Used **GCP credentials provided during the hackathon** - Leveraged **$10 GCP credits** for experimentation and deployment - MCP-based agents connected to external APIs and tools --- ## 🛠️ Tech Stack - Python - MCP (Model Context Protocol) - Google Vertex AI - GCP APIs - Satellite & Sensor APIs - Vision Models (YOLO / segmentation) - Geospatial analysis tools --- ## 🚀 Roadmap (Post-Hackathon) Planned enhancements: - 🔔 Real-time alerting - Email notifications - SMS alerts - WhatsApp integration - 📊 Dashboards for authorities - 🧠 Improved long-term risk prediction - 🌐 City-wise scalable deployment > These features were planned but not completed within the hackathon timeline. --- ## 🏆 Hackathon Built at **Google Agentic AI World’s Biggest Hackathon — Hyderabad** This project demonstrates the **practical power of MCP-driven agentic AI** for: - Autonomous detection - Continuous monitoring - Predictive modeling - Multi-agent collaboration
